description: A relation \(R\subseteq A\times B\) has exactly one related output for every input if and only if it is the graph of some map \(f:A\to B\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.function_graph_characterization.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (R : Set (α × β)) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.isFunctionGraph R ↔ ∃ f, R = Set.graphOn f Set.univ
